# Shortcuts

*This page is generated from the application; do not edit it by hand.*

<!-- Regenerate with: UPDATE_MANUAL_PAGES=1 cargo test -p stokesforge-app --lib manual_pages -->

On macOS, Cmd replaces Ctrl.

The same list is shown by **Help ▸ Keyboard Shortcuts…**.

## General

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Undo | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> |
| Redo | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Y</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> |
| New project | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>N</kbd> |
| Open a project | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>O</kbd> |
| Save | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> |
| Save as | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> |
| Import files | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>"</kbd> |
| Export the graph | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>E</kbd> |
| Run the script | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Enter</kbd> |

## Workbook

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Edit the cell or the header field | <kbd>F2</kbd> |
| Select all | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>A</kbd> |
| Copy | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> |
| Copy the whole columns | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> |
| Cut | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>X</kbd> |
| Paste | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> |
| Paste at the same place | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>V</kbd> |
| Clear the selected cells, then delete them | <kbd>Del</kbd> |
| Duplicate the sheet | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd> |

## Graph

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Copy the graph as an image (nothing selected) | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd> |
| Delete the selected object | <kbd>Del</kbd> |
| Move the selected series up | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Up</kbd> |
| Move the selected series down | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Down</kbd> |
| Zoom | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Wheel</kbd> |

## Project Manager and Object Manager

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Rename | <kbd>F2</kbd> |
| Delete the selection | <kbd>Del</kbd> |
| Duplicate | <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>D</kbd> |
| Select the previous or next row | <kbd>Up</kbd> / <kbd>Down</kbd> |
| Open the window, expand or collapse the folder | <kbd>Enter</kbd> |

## Fields and dialogs

| Action | Keys |
|---|---|
| Confirm | <kbd>Enter</kbd> |
| Cancel | <kbd>Esc</kbd> |
| Confirm and go to the next field | <kbd>Tab</kbd> |
| Change the number by one step | <kbd>Up</kbd> / <kbd>Down</kbd> |
| Change the number by ten steps | <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Up</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Down</kbd> |
| Open the list of values | <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Down</kbd> |
